let _drawerTab = 'graph';
let _drawerRequestId = 0;
let _campaignGraphState = null;
let _campaignGraphTimers = [];

const CAMPAIGN_GRAPH_TACTICS = [
  'reconnaissance','resource-development','initial-access','execution',
  'persistence','privilege-escalation','defense-evasion','credential-access',
  'discovery','lateral-movement','collection','command-and-control',
  'exfiltration','impact','unknown',
];

function switchDrawerTab(tab) {
  _drawerTab = tab;
  ['graph','reports','ttps','detection','binary'].forEach(t => {
    document.getElementById('dtab-'+t).classList.toggle('active', t === tab);
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-'+t).style.display = t === tab ? '' : 'none';
  });
  const body = document.querySelector('#session-drawer .drawer-body');
  body.classList.toggle('graph-active', tab === 'graph');
  if (tab === 'graph' && _campaignGraphState?.cy) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      _campaignGraphState.cy.resize();
      fitCampaignGraph();
    });
  }
}

function closeSessionDrawer(e) {
  if (e && e.target !== document.getElementById('session-drawer-overlay')) return;
  _drawerRequestId += 1;
  document.getElementById('session-drawer-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('session-drawer').classList.remove('graph-enabled');
  destroyCampaignGraph();
}

function destroyCampaignGraph() {
  _campaignGraphTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);
  _campaignGraphTimers = [];
  if (_campaignGraphState?.cy) _campaignGraphState.cy.destroy();
  const shell = document.getElementById('campaign-graph-shell');
  if (shell) shell.classList.remove('graph-presentation');
  _campaignGraphState = null;
}

function campaignGraphShort(value, maxLength) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return text.length > maxLength ? `${text.slice(0, maxLength - 1)}…` : text;
}

function campaignGraphTacticLabel(tactic) {
  if (tactic === 'command-and-control') return 'Command & Control';
  return String(tactic || 'unknown').split('-')
    .map(word => word ? word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1) : '')
    .join(' ');
}

function campaignGraphHttpUrl(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(String(value || ''));
    return url.protocol === 'http:' || url.protocol === 'https:' ? url.href : '';
  } catch (e) {
    return '';
  }
}

function campaignGraphDomain(value) {
  try {
    return new URL(String(value || '')).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
  } catch (e) {
    return '';
  }
}

function campaignGraphElements(state) {
  const {stages, mode} = state;
  const presentTactics = [...new Set(stages.map(stage => stage.tactic || 'unknown'))]
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const ai = CAMPAIGN_GRAPH_TACTICS.indexOf(a);
      const bi = CAMPAIGN_GRAPH_TACTICS.indexOf(b);
      return (ai < 0 ? 999 : ai) - (bi < 0 ? 999 : bi) || a.localeCompare(b);
    });
  const rowCounts = {};
  stages.forEach(stage => {
    const tactic = stage.tactic || 'unknown';
    rowCounts[tactic] = (rowCounts[tactic] || 0) + 1;
  });
  const maxRows = Math.max(1, ...Object.values(rowCounts));
  const rowGap = mode === 'evidence' ? 132 : mode === 'hunt' ? 108 : 82;
  const laneWidth = mode === 'campaign' ? 188 : 236;
  const laneGap = mode === 'campaign' ? 208 : 252;
  const laneHeight = Math.max(470, 126 + (maxRows - 1) * rowGap + 108);
  const firstLaneX = 286;
  const laneX = Object.fromEntries(presentTactics.map((tactic, idx) => [tactic, firstLaneX + idx * laneGap]));
  const laneRows = {};
  const elements = [];

  presentTactics.forEach(tactic => {
    const color = TACTIC_COLORS[tactic] || TACTIC_COLORS.unknown;
    elements.push({
      group: 'nodes',
      data: {
        id: `lane-${tactic}`,
        label: campaignGraphTacticLabel(tactic),
        width: laneWidth,
        height: laneHeight,
        color,
      },
      position: {x: laneX[tactic], y: laneHeight / 2 + 18},
      classes: 'lane',
    });
  });

  elements.push({
    group: 'nodes',
    data: {id: 'campaign-actor', label: campaignGraphShort(state.session.actor_id || 'campaign', 20)},
    position: {x: 74, y: laneHeight / 2 + 18},
    classes: 'actor',
  });

  stages.forEach((stage, index) => {
    const tactic = stage.tactic || 'unknown';
    const row = laneRows[tactic] || 0;
    laneRows[tactic] = row + 1;
    const position = {x: laneX[tactic], y: 96 + row * rowGap};
    const color = mode === 'hunt'
      ? (stage.detection?.covered ? '#56D98A' : '#FF7875')
      : (TACTIC_COLORS[tactic] || TACTIC_COLORS.unknown);
    elements.push({
      group: 'nodes',
      data: {
        id: `campaign-stage-${index}`,
        label: `${stage.stage_num || index + 1}. ${stage.ttp_id || 'TTP'}\n${campaignGraphShort(stage.ttp_name || stage.module_title || '', 28)}`,
        stageIndex: index,
        color,
      },
      position,
      classes: `stage ${stage.detection?.covered ? 'covered' : 'blind'}`,
    });
    const source = index ? `campaign-stage-${index - 1}` : 'campaign-actor';
    elements.push({
      group: 'edges',
      data: {id: `campaign-path-${index}`, source, target: `campaign-stage-${index}`, targetIndex: index},
      classes: 'campaign-edge',
    });

    if (mode === 'hunt') {
      const detection = stage.detection || {};
      const sigmaCount = Number(detection.sigma_count || 0);
      const eventCount = (detection.event_ids || []).length;
      elements.push({
        group: 'nodes',
        data: {
          id: `campaign-detection-${index}`,
          label: detection.covered ? `${sigmaCount} SIGMA · ${eventCount} EVENTS` : 'BLIND SPOT',
          ownerIndex: index,
        },
        position: {x: position.x, y: position.y + 47},
        classes: `aux detection ${detection.covered ? 'covered' : 'blind'}`,
      });
      elements.push({
        group: 'edges',
        data: {id: `campaign-detection-edge-${index}`, source: `campaign-stage-${index}`, target: `campaign-detection-${index}`, ownerIndex: index},
        classes: `aux-edge detection-edge ${detection.covered ? 'covered' : 'blind'}`,
      });
    } else if (mode === 'evidence') {
      const reportLabel = campaignGraphShort(stage.report_title || campaignGraphDomain(stage.report_url) || 'report evidence', 20);
      const implementationLabel = campaignGraphShort(stage.module_slug || stage.module_title || stage._out_bin || 'implementation', 20);
      elements.push({
        group: 'nodes',
        data: {id: `campaign-report-${index}`, label: `REPORT\n${reportLabel}`, ownerIndex: index},
        position: {x: position.x - 48, y: position.y - 43},
        classes: 'aux report',
      });
      elements.push({
        group: 'nodes',
        data: {id: `campaign-artifact-${index}`, label: `IMPLEMENTATION\n${implementationLabel}`, ownerIndex: index},
        position: {x: position.x + 48, y: position.y + 43},
        classes: 'aux artifact',
      });
      elements.push({
        group: 'edges',
        data: {id: `campaign-report-edge-${index}`, source: `campaign-report-${index}`, target: `campaign-stage-${index}`, ownerIndex: index},
        classes: 'aux-edge report-edge',
      });
      elements.push({
        group: 'edges',
        data: {id: `campaign-artifact-edge-${index}`, source: `campaign-stage-${index}`, target: `campaign-artifact-${index}`, ownerIndex: index},
        classes: 'aux-edge artifact-edge',
      });
    }
  });
  return elements;
}

function renderCampaignGraph(payload, sessionId) {
  const container = document.getElementById('drawer-tab-graph');
  const stages = Array.isArray(payload.stages)
    ? [...payload.stages].sort((a, b) => Number(a.stage_num || 0) - Number(b.stage_num || 0))
    : [];
  if (!stages.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="campaign-graph-empty">No simulated campaign stages in this session</div>';
    return;
  }
  const detection = payload.params.detection || {};
  const tacticCount = new Set(stages.map(stage => stage.tactic || 'unknown')).size;
  const buildCount = stages.filter(stage => stage._out_bin).length;
  const coverage = Number(detection.coverage_pct || 0);
  container.innerHTML = `
    <section class="campaign-graph" id="campaign-graph-shell" tabindex="0" role="region"
             aria-label="${escAttr(payload.session.actor_id || 'Campaign')} threat path"
             onkeydown="campaignGraphKey(event)">
      <div class="campaign-graph-head">
        <div class="campaign-graph-title">
          <div class="campaign-graph-eyebrow">threat path</div>
          <div class="campaign-graph-name">${escHtml(payload.session.actor_id || 'campaign')}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="campaign-graph-metrics">
          <span class="campaign-graph-metric">${stages.length} stages</span>
          <span class="campaign-graph-metric">${tacticCount} tactics</span>
          <span class="campaign-graph-metric">${coverage}% coverage</span>
          <span class="campaign-graph-metric">${buildCount}/${stages.length} builds</span>
        </div>
        <div class="campaign-graph-controls">
          <div class="campaign-graph-modes" role="group" aria-label="Graph mode">
            <button type="button" class="campaign-graph-mode active" data-graph-mode="campaign" aria-pressed="true" onclick="setCampaignGraphMode('campaign')">Campaign</button>
            <button type="button" class="campaign-graph-mode" data-graph-mode="hunt" aria-pressed="false" onclick="setCampaignGraphMode('hunt')">Hunt</button>
            <button type="button" class="campaign-graph-mode" data-graph-mode="evidence" aria-pressed="false" onclick="setCampaignGraphMode('evidence')">Evidence</button>
          </div>
          <div class="campaign-graph-tools">
            <button type="button" class="campaign-graph-icon" onclick="replayCampaignGraph()" title="Replay campaign" aria-label="Replay campaign">↻</button>
            <button type="button" class="campaign-graph-icon" onclick="fitCampaignGraph()" title="Fit graph" aria-label="Fit graph">⌂</button>
            <button type="button" class="campaign-graph-icon" id="campaign-graph-presentation" onclick="toggleCampaignGraphPresentation()" title="Presentation mode" aria-label="Presentation mode">⛶</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="campaign-graph-workspace">
        <div class="campaign-graph-canvas-wrap">
          <div class="campaign-graph-canvas" id="campaign-graph-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="campaign-graph-mode-label" id="campaign-graph-mode-label">campaign path</div>
        </div>
        <aside class="campaign-graph-detail" id="campaign-graph-detail" aria-live="polite"></aside>
      </div>
    </section>`;
  _campaignGraphState = {
    cy: null,
    sessionId,
    session: payload.session,
    sample: payload.sample,
    reportSources: payload.reportSources,
    params: payload.params,
    stages,
    mode: 'campaign',
    selectedStage: stages.length - 1,
    focused: false,
  };
  document.getElementById('session-drawer').classList.add('graph-enabled');
  buildCampaignGraph(true);
}

function buildCampaignGraph(animate) {
  const state = _campaignGraphState;
  const container = document.getElementById('campaign-graph-canvas');
  if (!state || !container) return;
  if (state.cy) state.cy.destroy();
  if (typeof cytoscape !== 'function') {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="campaign-graph-empty">Graph runtime unavailable</div>';
    return;
  }
  state.cy = cytoscape({
    container,
    elements: campaignGraphElements(state),
    style: campaignGraphStyles(),
    layout: {name:'preset', fit:true, padding:28, animate:false},
    minZoom:.24,
    maxZoom:2.2,
    boxSelectionEnabled:false,
    autoungrabify:true,
  });
  state.cy.on('tap', 'node.stage, node.aux', event => {
    const index = Number(event.target.data('stageIndex') ?? event.target.data('ownerIndex'));
    if (Number.isInteger(index)) selectCampaignGraphStage(index, true);
  });
  state.cy.on('tap', 'node.actor', () => selectCampaignGraphStage(0, true));
  state.cy.on('tap', event => {
    if (event.target !== state.cy) return;
    state.focused = false;
    selectCampaignGraphStage(state.selectedStage, false, false);
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    if (!_campaignGraphState?.cy) return;
    fitCampaignGraph();
    selectCampaignGraphStage(state.selectedStage, false, state.focused);
    if (animate) replayCampaignGraph();
  });
}

function selectCampaignGraphStage(index, center, focus = true) {
  const state = _campaignGraphState;
  if (!state?.cy || !state.stages.length) return;
  const nextIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(state.stages.length - 1, Number(index) || 0));
  state.selectedStage = nextIndex;
  state.focused = focus;
  const cy = state.cy;
  cy.elements().removeClass('selected route related muted');
  cy.$('#campaign-actor').addClass('route');
  if (focus) {
    cy.$('node.stage, node.aux, edge').addClass('muted');
    for (let i = 0; i <= nextIndex; i += 1) {
      cy.$(`#campaign-stage-${i}, #campaign-path-${i}`).removeClass('muted').addClass('route');
    }
    [nextIndex - 1, nextIndex + 1].forEach(i => {
      if (i >= 0 && i < state.stages.length) cy.$(`#campaign-stage-${i}`).removeClass('muted').addClass('related');
    });
    cy.$(`[ownerIndex = ${nextIndex}]`).removeClass('muted').addClass('related');
  } else {
    cy.$('edge.campaign-edge, node.stage').addClass('route');
  }
  cy.$(`#campaign-stage-${nextIndex}`).removeClass('related muted').addClass('selected');
  renderCampaignGraphDetail(nextIndex);
  if (center) cy.animate({center:{eles:cy.$(`#campaign-stage-${nextIndex}`)}, duration:220});
}

function renderCampaignGraphDetail(index) {
  const state = _campaignGraphState;
  const detail = document.getElementById('campaign-graph-detail');
  const stage = state?.stages[index];
  if (!detail || !stage) return;
  const detection = stage.detection || {};
  const tacticColor = TACTIC_COLORS[stage.tactic] || TACTIC_COLORS.unknown;
  const reportUrl = campaignGraphHttpUrl(stage.report_url);
  const blogUrl = campaignGraphHttpUrl(stage.blog_url);
  const reportTitle = stage.report_title || campaignGraphDomain(stage.report_url) || 'Source report';
  const eventIds = (detection.event_ids || []).slice(0, 12);
  const rules = (detection.sigma_rules || []).slice(0, 5);
  const downloadBase = `/api/samples/${encodeURIComponent(state.sessionId)}/download/`;
  const buildLinks = [
    stage._out_src ? `<a class="campaign-detail-link" href="${downloadBase}${encodeURIComponent(stage._out_src)}">Source · ${escHtml(stage._out_src)}</a>` : '',
    stage._out_bin ? `<a class="campaign-detail-link" href="${downloadBase}${encodeURIComponent(stage._out_bin)}">Binary · ${escHtml(stage._out_bin)}</a>` : '',
  ].filter(Boolean).join('');
  const ruleRows = rules.map(rule => {
    const level = String(rule.level || '').toLowerCase();
    return `<div class="campaign-detail-rule"><span class="campaign-detail-rule-level ${escAttr(level)}"></span><span>${escHtml(rule.title || 'Sigma rule')}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
  detail.innerHTML = `
    <div class="campaign-detail-top">
      <span class="campaign-detail-step">stage ${index + 1} / ${state.stages.length}</span>
      <div class="campaign-detail-nav">
        <button type="button" onclick="campaignGraphNavigate(-1)" title="Previous stage" aria-label="Previous stage" ${index === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>←</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="campaignGraphNavigate(1)" title="Next stage" aria-label="Next stage" ${index === state.stages.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}>→</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="campaign-detail-id">${escHtml(stage.ttp_id || '')}</div>
    <div class="campaign-detail-title">${escHtml(stage.ttp_name || stage.module_title || 'Campaign stage')}</div>
    <span class="campaign-detail-tactic" style="color:${tacticColor};background:${tacticColor}18">${escHtml(campaignGraphTacticLabel(stage.tactic))}</span>
    <div class="campaign-detail-section">
      <div class="campaign-detail-label">report evidence</div>
      <div class="campaign-detail-evidence">${escHtml(stage.evidence || 'No evidence quote stored for this stage.')}</div>
      ${reportUrl ? `<a class="campaign-detail-link" href="${escAttr(reportUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${escHtml(reportTitle)} ↗</a>` : ''}
    </div>
    <div class="campaign-detail-section">
      <div class="campaign-detail-label">implementation</div>
      <div class="campaign-detail-evidence">${escHtml(stage.module_title || stage.module_slug || 'No implementation linked')}</div>
      <div class="campaign-detail-facts" style="margin-top:8px">
        ${stage.platform ? `<span class="campaign-detail-fact">${escHtml(stage.platform)}</span>` : ''}
        ${stage.compiler ? `<span class="campaign-detail-fact">${escHtml(stage.compiler)}</span>` : ''}
        ${stage.src_name ? `<span class="campaign-detail-fact">${escHtml(stage.src_name)}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${blogUrl ? `<a class="campaign-detail-link" href="${escAttr(blogUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Blog implementation ↗</a>` : ''}
      ${buildLinks}
    </div>
    <div class="campaign-detail-section">
      <div class="campaign-detail-label">detection</div>
      <div class="campaign-detail-facts">
        <span class="campaign-detail-fact" style="color:${detection.covered ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)'}">${detection.covered ? 'covered' : 'blind spot'}</span>
        <span class="campaign-detail-fact">${Number(detection.sigma_count || 0)} sigma</span>
        <span class="campaign-detail-fact">${(detection.event_ids || []).length} EventIDs</span>
      </div>
      ${eventIds.length ? `<div class="campaign-detail-evidence" style="margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px">EventID ${escHtml(eventIds.join(', '))}</div>` : ''}
      ${ruleRows ? `<div class="campaign-detail-rules" style="margin-top:9px">${ruleRows}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`;
}

function setCampaignGraphMode(mode) {
  const state = _campaignGraphState;
  if (!state || !['campaign','hunt','evidence'].includes(mode) || state.mode === mode) return;
  state.mode = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-graph-mode]').forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.graphMode === mode;
    button.classList.toggle('active', active);
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  });
  const labels = {campaign:'campaign path',hunt:'purple-team overlay',evidence:'evidence chain'};
  document.getElementById('campaign-graph-mode-label').textContent = labels[mode];
  buildCampaignGraph(false);
}

function replayCampaignGraph() {
  const state = _campaignGraphState;
  if (!state?.cy) return;
  _campaignGraphTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);
  _campaignGraphTimers = [];
  const cy = state.cy;
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  cy.elements().removeClass('cg-hidden');
  if (reducedMotion) {
    selectCampaignGraphStage(state.selectedStage, false, state.focused);
    return;
  }
  cy.$('node.stage, node.aux, edge').addClass('cg-hidden');
  const stepDuration = Math.max(42, Math.min(170, Math.floor(1650 / state.stages.length)));
  state.stages.forEach((stage, index) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!_campaignGraphState?.cy) return;
      cy.$(`#campaign-stage-${index}, #campaign-path-${index}`).removeClass('cg-hidden');
      cy.$(`[ownerIndex = ${index}]`).removeClass('cg-hidden');
      if (index === state.stages.length - 1) selectCampaignGraphStage(state.selectedStage, false, state.focused);
    }, 80 + index * stepDuration);
    _campaignGraphTimers.push(timer);
  });
}

function fitCampaignGraph() {
  const state = _campaignGraphState;
  if (!state?.cy) return;
  const cy = state.cy;
  cy.resize();
  cy.fit(cy.elements(), 28);
  const readableZoom = window.innerWidth <= 760 ? .3 : .5;
  if (cy.zoom() < readableZoom) {
    cy.zoom(readableZoom);
    cy.center(cy.$(`#campaign-stage-${state.selectedStage}`));
  }
}

function campaignGraphNavigate(delta) {
  if (!_campaignGraphState) return;
  selectCampaignGraphStage(_campaignGraphState.selectedStage + delta, true);
}

function campaignGraphKey(event) {
  if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
  event.preventDefault();
  campaignGraphNavigate(event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 1);
}

async function toggleCampaignGraphPresentation() {
  const shell = document.getElementById('campaign-graph-shell');
  if (!shell) return;
  try {
    if (document.fullscreenElement === shell) {
      await document.exitFullscreen();
    } else if (shell.requestFullscreen) {
      await shell.requestFullscreen();
    } else {
      shell.classList.toggle('graph-presentation');
      syncCampaignGraphPresentation();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    shell.classList.toggle('graph-presentation');
    syncCampaignGraphPresentation();
  }
}

function syncCampaignGraphPresentation() {
  const shell = document.getElementById('campaign-graph-shell');
  const button = document.getElementById('campaign-graph-presentation');
  if (!shell) return;
  const active = document.fullscreenElement === shell || shell.classList.contains('graph-presentation');
  if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    if (!_campaignGraphState?.cy) return;
    _campaignGraphState.cy.resize();
    fitCampaignGraph();
  });
}
document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', syncCampaignGraphPresentation);


async function openSessionDrawer(sessionId) {
  destroyCampaignGraph();
  const requestId = ++_drawerRequestId;
  const overlay = document.getElementById('session-drawer-overlay');
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('drawer-title').textContent = `Session ${sessionId}`;
  document.getElementById('drawer-subtitle').textContent = 'loading…';
  document.getElementById('drawer-status-badge').textContent = '';
  ['graph','reports','ttps','detection','binary'].forEach(t => {
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-'+t).innerHTML =
      '<div class="loading-full" style="padding:30px"><div class="spinner"></div></div>';
  });
  switchDrawerTab('graph');

  let d;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/pipeline/session/${encodeURIComponent(sessionId)}`);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
    d = await response.json();
  } catch(e) {
    if (requestId !== _drawerRequestId) return;
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-graph').innerHTML =
      '<div class="text-dim" style="padding:20px">failed to load</div>';
    return;
  }
  if (requestId !== _drawerRequestId) return;

  const sess = d.session || {};
  document.getElementById('drawer-subtitle').textContent =
    `${sess.actor_id || ''}  ·  started ${(sess.started||'').slice(0,16)}`;
  const stCls = sess.status === 'success' ? 'badge-green'
              : sess.status === 'running'  ? 'badge-yellow' : 'badge-red';
  document.getElementById('drawer-status-badge').className = `badge ${stCls}`;
  document.getElementById('drawer-status-badge').textContent = sess.status || '';

  // ---- Reports tab ----
  const reports = d.reports || [];
  const reportSources = d.report_sources || (sess.params || {}).report_sources || [];

  if (!reports.length && !reportSources.length) {
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-reports').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty" style="padding:40px"><div class="empty-icon">📄</div><div>No reports in DB for this session</div></div>';
  } else if (reports.length) {
    const rows = reports.map(r => {
      const chars = (r.content || '').length;
      return `<a class="report-link-row" href="${escAttr(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <span class="badge badge-dim" style="font-size:9px;flex-shrink:0">#${r.idx}</span>
        <span class="mono text-xs" style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--blue)"
              title="${escAttr(r.url)}">${escHtml(r.url)}</span>
        <span class="text-xs text-dim" style="flex-shrink:0">${chars.toLocaleString()} chars</span>
      </a>`;
    }).join('');
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-reports').innerHTML =
      `<div style="margin-bottom:10px" class="text-xs text-dim">${reports.length} report(s) downloaded</div>
       <div style="background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--sep);border-radius:var(--rs);overflow:hidden">${rows}</div>`;
  } else {
    const rows = reportSources.map((r, i) => {
      const chars = Number(r.text_chars || 0);
      const status = r.status || 'ok';
      const title = r.title || r.url;
      return `<a class="report-link-row" href="${escAttr(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <span class="badge badge-dim" style="font-size:9px;flex-shrink:0">#${i+1}</span>
        <span class="mono text-xs" style="flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--blue)"
              title="${escAttr(r.url)}">${escHtml(title)}</span>
        <span class="badge badge-dim text-xs" style="flex-shrink:0">${escHtml(status)}</span>
        ${chars ? `<span class="text-xs text-dim" style="flex-shrink:0">${chars.toLocaleString()} chars</span>` : ''}
      </a>`;
    }).join('');
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-reports').innerHTML =
      `<div style="margin-bottom:10px" class="text-xs text-dim">${reportSources.length} precomputed report source(s)</div>
       <div style="background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--sep);border-radius:var(--rs);overflow:hidden">${rows}</div>`;
  }

  // ---- TTPs tab ----
  const ttps = sess.ttps || [];
  if (!ttps.length) {
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-ttps').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty" style="padding:40px"><div class="empty-icon">🔍</div><div>No TTPs recorded</div></div>';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-ttps').innerHTML = `
      <div style="margin-bottom:10px" class="text-xs text-dim">${ttps.length} technique(s) extracted</div>
      <div class="ttp-grid">${ttps.map(t => {
        const col = TACTIC_COLORS[t.tactic] || TACTIC_COLORS.unknown;
        return `<div class="ttp-item">
          <span class="badge badge-red" style="font-family:var(--mono);min-width:72px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer"
                onclick="showBrief('${escAttr(t.id)}','art')" title="Detection brief">${escHtml(t.id)}</span>
          <span style="flex:1">${escHtml(t.name||t.id)}</span>
          <span class="badge" style="background:${col}22;color:${col};font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap">${escHtml(t.tactic)}</span>
          ${t.report_url
            ? `<a class="text-xs" style="color:var(--blue)" href="${escAttr(t.report_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="${escAttr(t.report_title || t.report_url)}">report ↗</a>`
            : (t.source ? `<span class="text-xs text-dim">${escHtml(t.source)}</span>` : '')}
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  // ---- Binary tab ----
  const sample = d.sample;
  const params = sess.params || {};
  if (!sample || !(sample.files||[]).length) {
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-binary').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty" style="padding:40px"><div class="empty-icon">💾</div><div>No compiled binary for this session</div></div>';
  } else {
    const files = (sample.files||[]).map(f =>
      `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--sep)">
        <span style="font-size:20px">💾</span>
        <div style="flex:1">
          <div class="mono text-sm">${escHtml(f.name)}</div>
          <div class="text-xs text-dim">${formatBytes(f.size)}</div>
        </div>
        <a href="/api/samples/${sessionId}/download/${encodeURIComponent(f.name)}"
           class="btn btn-green btn-sm">⬇ Download</a>
      </div>`).join('');
    const paramBadges = ['encryption','malware','injection','stealer','persistence']
      .filter(k => params[k] && params[k] !== 'none')
      .map(k => `<span class="badge badge-dim">${k}: ${escHtml(params[k])}</span>`).join('');
    const mods = (params.selected_modules||[]).map(m => {
      const title = m.blog_url
        ? `<a href="${escAttr(m.blog_url)}" target="_blank" class="text-sm" style="flex:1;color:var(--cyan)">${escHtml(m.title||m.module_id)}</a>`
        : `<span class="text-sm" style="flex:1">${escHtml(m.title||m.module_id)}</span>`;
      const score = m.selection_score ? `<span class="badge badge-dim text-xs">score ${escHtml(m.selection_score)}</span>` : '';
      return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--sep)">
        <span class="badge badge-red" style="font-size:10px;min-width:60px;text-align:center">${escHtml(m.attack_id)}</span>
        ${title}
        ${score}
        <span class="badge badge-dim text-xs">${escHtml(m.category)}</span>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
    document.getElementById('drawer-tab-binary').innerHTML = `
      ${paramBadges ? `<div class="card card-sm" style="margin-bottom:14px">
        <div class="text-xs text-dim" style="margin-bottom:8px">Build configuration</div>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px">${paramBadges}</div>
      </div>` : ''}
      <div class="card card-sm" style="margin-bottom:14px">
        <div class="text-xs text-dim" style="margin-bottom:8px">
          Files &mdash; total ${formatBytes(sample.total_size||0)}
        </div>
        ${files}
      </div>
      ${mods ? `<div class="card card-sm">
        <div class="text-xs text-dim" style="margin-bottom:8px">Selected modules (${(params.selected_modules||[]).length})</div>
        ${mods}
      </div>` : ''}`;
  }

  // ---- Detection tab (purple-team hunt sheet) ----
  const det    = params.detection || {};
  const stages = params.stages || [];
  const detEl  = document.getElementById('drawer-tab-detection');
  if (!det.stages_total) {
    detEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty" style="padding:40px"><div class="empty-icon">🛡</div><div>No detection overlay for this session<br><span class="text-xs text-dim">re-run the pipeline to generate one</span></div></div>';
  } else {
    const pct    = det.coverage_pct || 0;
    const barCol = pct >= 80 ? 'var(--green)' : pct >= 50 ? '#e5c07b' : 'var(--red)';
    const stageRows = stages.map(s => {
      const dd  = s.detection || {};
      const col = TACTIC_COLORS[s.tactic] || TACTIC_COLORS.unknown;
      const head = `<span class="badge badge-red text-xs" style="font-family:var(--mono)">${escHtml(s.ttp_id||'')}</span>
        <span class="badge text-xs" style="background:${col}22;color:${col}">${escHtml(s.tactic||'')}</span>
        <span class="detect-name">${escHtml(s.ttp_name||s.ttp_id||'')}</span>`;
      if (dd.covered) {
        const eids = (dd.event_ids||[]).slice(0,8).join(', ');
        return `<div class="detect-item">${head}
          <span class="detect-tail"><span class="badge badge-green text-xs">${dd.sigma_count||0} sigma</span></span>
          ${eids ? `<span class="detect-events">EventID ${escHtml(eids)}</span>` : ''}
        </div>`;
      }
      const yara = dd.yara_file
        ? `<a href="/api/samples/${sessionId}/download/${encodeURIComponent(dd.yara_file)}" class="btn btn-green btn-sm">⬇ ${escHtml(dd.yara_file)}</a>`
        : `<span class="text-xs text-dim">${escHtml(dd.yara_hint||'')}</span>`;
      return `<div class="detect-item">${head}
        <span class="detect-tail"><span class="badge badge-red text-xs">NO SIGMA</span>${yara}</span>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
    detEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="detect-summary">
        <span class="text-xs text-dim">coverage</span>
        <div class="detect-bar">
          <div style="width:${pct}%;height:100%;background:${barCol}"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="text-sm" style="color:${barCol}">${pct}%</span>
        <span class="text-xs text-dim">${det.stages_covered||0}/${det.stages_total} stages · ${det.unique_sigma||0} sigma · ${(det.unique_event_ids||[]).length} EventIDs · ${(det.gaps||[]).length} blind spot(s)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="detect-grid">${stageRows}</div>`;
  }

  renderCampaignGraph({
    session: sess,
    sample: d.sample,
    reportSources,
    params,
    stages,
  }, sessionId);
}

let _vtSamples         = [];
let _vtCurrentScan     = null;
let _vtPollTimer       = null;
let _vtAllResults      = {};
let _vtSelectedSession = '';
let _vtSelectedFile    = '';

// ----- custom dropdown helpers -----
function vtToggleDrop(id) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  const wasOpen = el.classList.contains('vt-open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.vt-select.vt-open').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('vt-open'));
  if (!wasOpen) el.classList.add('vt-open');
}
function vtCloseDrop(id) {
  document.getElementById(id)?.classList.remove('vt-open');
}
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.vt-select')) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.vt-select.vt-open').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('vt-open'));
  }
});

function vtSelectSession(sid, label) {
  _vtSelectedSession = sid;
  const lbl = document.getElementById('vt-session-label');
  lbl.textContent = label;
  lbl.className = '';
  document.querySelectorAll('#vt-session-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o =>
    o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.sid === sid));
  vtCloseDrop('vt-session-drop');
  vtUpdateFileList();
}

function vtSelectFile(fname, label) {
  _vtSelectedFile = fname;
  const lbl = document.getElementById('vt-file-label');
  lbl.textContent = label;
  lbl.className = '';
  document.querySelectorAll('#vt-file-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o =>
    o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.fname === fname));
  vtCloseDrop('vt-file-drop');
}

async function loadVtScanner() {
  const samples = await fetch('/api/samples').then(r => r.json()).catch(() => []);
  _vtSamples = samples;
  _vtSelectedSession = '';
  _vtSelectedFile    = '';

  const menu = document.getElementById('vt-session-menu');
  menu.innerHTML = '';

  if (samples.length) {
    for (const s of samples) {
      const nf    = (s.files || []).length;
      const label = `${s.session_id}${s.actor ? '  ·  ' + s.actor : ''}  (${nf} file${nf !== 1 ? 's' : ''})`;
      const div   = document.createElement('div');
      div.className     = 'vt-select-opt';
      div.textContent   = label;
      div.dataset.sid   = s.session_id;
      div.onclick       = () => vtSelectSession(s.session_id, label);
      menu.appendChild(div);
    }
  } else {
    menu.innerHTML = '<div class="vt-select-opt vt-ph">no samples found</div>';
  }

  // reset file menu & labels
  document.getElementById('vt-file-menu').innerHTML = '';
  const sl = document.getElementById('vt-session-label');
  sl.textContent = '- select session -'; sl.className = 'vt-ph';
  const fl = document.getElementById('vt-file-label');
  fl.textContent = '- select file -';   fl.className = 'vt-ph';
}

function vtUpdateFileList() {
  _vtSelectedFile = '';
  const fl = document.getElementById('vt-file-label');
  fl.textContent = '- select file -'; fl.className = 'vt-ph';

  const menu   = document.getElementById('vt-file-menu');
  menu.innerHTML = '';

  const sample = _vtSamples.find(s => s.session_id === _vtSelectedSession);
  if (!sample || !(sample.files || []).length) {
    menu.innerHTML = '<div class="vt-select-opt vt-ph">no files found</div>';
    return;
  }

  for (const f of sample.files) {
    const kb    = f.size > 1024 ? (f.size / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB' : f.size + ' B';
    const label = `${f.name}  (${kb})`;
    const div   = document.createElement('div');
    div.className     = 'vt-select-opt';
    div.textContent   = label;
    div.dataset.fname = f.name;
    div.onclick       = () => vtSelectFile(f.name, label);
    menu.appendChild(div);
  }
}

async function vtStartScan() {
  const sid   = _vtSelectedSession;
  const fname = _vtSelectedFile;
  if (!sid || !fname) { toast('Select a session and file first', 'warn'); return; }

  // reset
  if (_vtPollTimer) { clearInterval(_vtPollTimer); _vtPollTimer = null; }
  document.getElementById('vt-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display    = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = '';
  _vtSetProgress('⏳', 'Uploading…', 10, `uploading ${fname}…`);
  document.getElementById('vt-scan-btn').disabled = true;

  const r = await fetch('/api/vtscan/upload', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({session_id: sid, filename: fname}),
  }).then(r => r.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  if (!r.ok) {
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('vt-scan-btn').disabled = false;
    toast('Scan error: ' + r.error, 'error');
    return;
  }

  if (r.cached) {
    _vtShowResults(r);
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('vt-scan-btn').disabled = false;
    toast('Loaded cached VT results', 'ok');
    return;
  }

  // start polling
  _vtCurrentScan = {analysis_id: r.analysis_id, sha256: r.sha256};
  _vtSetProgress('🔬', 'Analyzing…', 40, 'analysis queued - polling (may take 1-3 min)…');
  _vtPollTimer = setInterval(_vtPollAnalysis, 9000);
  _vtPollAnalysis();
}

async function _vtPollAnalysis() {
  if (!_vtCurrentScan) return;
  const r = await fetch(`/api/vtscan/analysis/${_vtCurrentScan.analysis_id}`)
    .then(r => r.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  if (!r.ok) {
    clearInterval(_vtPollTimer); _vtPollTimer = null;
    // fallback: try by hash
    const r2 = await fetch(`/api/vtscan/file/${_vtCurrentScan.sha256}`)
      .then(r => r.json()).catch(() => ({ok: false}));
    document.getElementById('vt-scan-btn').disabled = false;
    if (r2.ok && r2.stats) {
      _vtShowResults(r2);
      document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('vt-progress-msg').textContent = 'poll error: ' + (r.error || 'unknown');
    }
    return;
  }

  if (r.status === 'completed') {
    clearInterval(_vtPollTimer); _vtPollTimer = null;
    document.getElementById('vt-scan-btn').disabled = false;
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    _vtShowResults(r);
    return;
  }

  const cur = parseInt(document.getElementById('vt-progress-fill').style.width) || 40;
  _vtSetProgress('🔬', 'Analyzing…', Math.min(cur + 6, 90), `status: ${r.status}…`);
}

function _vtSetProgress(icon, title, pct, msg) {
  document.getElementById('vt-progress-icon').textContent  = icon;
  document.getElementById('vt-progress-title').textContent = title;
  document.getElementById('vt-progress-fill').style.width  = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('vt-progress-msg').textContent   = msg;
}

let _vtSelectedBuild = '';
let _vtSelectedFname = '';

function vtSetTab(tab) {
  document.getElementById('vt-src-sample').style.display = tab === 'sample' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-src-build').style.display  = tab === 'build'  ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-src-upload').style.display = tab === 'upload' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-tab-sample').className = tab === 'sample' ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
  document.getElementById('vt-tab-build').className  = tab === 'build'  ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
  document.getElementById('vt-tab-upload').className = tab === 'upload' ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
  document.getElementById('vt-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display    = '';
  document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
  if (_vtPollTimer) { clearInterval(_vtPollTimer); _vtPollTimer = null; }
  if (tab === 'build' && !document.getElementById('vt-build-menu').children.length) {
    loadVtBuilds();
  }
}

async function loadVtBuilds() {
  const builds = await fetch('/api/logs?limit=50').then(r => r.json()).catch(() => []);
  const menu = document.getElementById('vt-build-menu');
  menu.innerHTML = '';
  const available = builds.filter(b => b.status === 'success' && b.binary_files?.length);
  if (!available.length) {
    menu.innerHTML = '<div class="vt-select-opt vt-ph">no compiled binaries found</div>';
    return;
  }
  for (const b of available) {
    const p   = b.params || {};
    let mod;
    if (p.slug)                       mod = p.slug;
    else if (p.malware === 'stealer') mod = p.stealer || b.id;
    else if (p.malware === 'ttp')     mod = p.meow_slug || p.attack_id || b.id;
    else                               mod = p.injection || b.id;
    for (const f of b.binary_files) {
      const label = `${b.id}  ·  ${mod}  (${f.name})  ${b.created?.slice(0,16)||''}`;
      const div   = document.createElement('div');
      div.className     = 'vt-select-opt';
      div.textContent   = label;
      div.dataset.bid   = b.id;
      div.dataset.fname = f.name;
      div.onclick = () => {
        _vtSelectedBuild = b.id;
        _vtSelectedFname = f.name;
        const lbl = document.getElementById('vt-build-label');
        lbl.textContent = label; lbl.className = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('#vt-build-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o =>
          o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.bid === b.id && o.dataset.fname === f.name));
        vtCloseDrop('vt-build-drop');
      };
      menu.appendChild(div);
    }
  }
}

async function vtScanFromBuild() {
  const bid = _vtSelectedBuild;
  if (!bid) { toast('Select a build first', 'warn'); return; }
  if (_vtPollTimer) { clearInterval(_vtPollTimer); _vtPollTimer = null; }
  document.getElementById('vt-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display    = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = '';
  _vtSetProgress('⏳', 'Uploading build binary…', 10, 'sending to VirusTotal…');
  document.getElementById('vt-build-scan-btn').disabled = true;

  const r = await fetch('/api/vtscan/from-build', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({build_id: bid, fname: _vtSelectedFname || undefined}),
  }).then(r => r.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  document.getElementById('vt-build-scan-btn').disabled = false;

  if (!r.ok) {
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display    = '';
    toast('Scan error: ' + r.error, 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (r.cached) {
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    _vtShowResults(r);
    toast('Loaded cached VT results', 'ok');
    return;
  }
  _vtCurrentScan = {analysis_id: r.analysis_id, sha256: r.sha256};
  _vtSetProgress('🔬', 'Analyzing…', 40, 'analysis queued - polling (may take 1-3 min)…');
  _vtPollTimer = setInterval(_vtPollAnalysis, 9000);
  _vtPollAnalysis();
}

async function vtFromBuildId(buildId, fname) {
  showPanel('coverage');
  vtSetTab('build');
  await loadVtBuilds();
  _vtSelectedBuild = buildId;
  _vtSelectedFname = fname;
  const lbl = document.getElementById('vt-build-label');
  lbl.textContent = `${buildId}  (${fname})`; lbl.className = '';
  document.querySelectorAll('#vt-build-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o =>
    o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.bid === buildId && o.dataset.fname === fname));
  vtScanFromBuild();
}

function vtHandleFile(file) {
  if (!file) return;
  const title = document.getElementById('vt-drop-zone').querySelector('.yara-drop-title');
  if (title) title.textContent = file.name;
  vtScanFromUpload(file);
}

function vtHandleDrop(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('vt-drop-zone').classList.remove('drag-over');
  const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
  if (file) vtHandleFile(file);
}

async function vtScanFromUpload(file) {
  if (_vtPollTimer) { clearInterval(_vtPollTimer); _vtPollTimer = null; }
  document.getElementById('vt-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display    = 'none';
  document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = '';
  _vtSetProgress('⏳', `Uploading ${file.name}…`, 15, 'sending file to VirusTotal…');

  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append('file', file, file.name);
  const r = await fetch('/api/vtscan/upload-raw', {method: 'POST', body: fd})
    .then(res => res.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  if (!r.ok) {
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('vt-empty').style.display    = '';
    toast('Upload error: ' + r.error, 'error');
    return;
  }
  if (r.cached) {
    document.getElementById('vt-progress').style.display = 'none';
    _vtShowResults(r);
    toast('Loaded cached VT results', 'ok');
    return;
  }
  _vtCurrentScan = {analysis_id: r.analysis_id, sha256: r.sha256};
  _vtSetProgress('🔬', 'Analyzing…', 40, 'analysis queued - polling (may take 1-3 min)…');
  _vtPollTimer = setInterval(_vtPollAnalysis, 9000);
  _vtPollAnalysis();
}

function _vtShowResults(data) {
  const stats   = data.stats   || {};
  const results = data.results || {};
  _vtAllResults = results;

  const malicious  = stats.malicious   || 0;
  const suspicious = stats.suspicious  || 0;
  const harmless   = (stats.harmless   || 0) + (stats.clean || 0);
  const undetected = stats.undetected  || 0;
  const total      = malicious + suspicious + harmless + undetected +
                     (stats.failure || 0) + (stats.type_unsupported || 0);
  const rate       = total > 0 ? Math.round(malicious / total * 100) : 0;
  const rateColor  = rate > 50 ? 'var(--red)' : rate > 15 ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--green)';

  document.getElementById('vt-result-stats').innerHTML = `
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--red)">${malicious}</div><div class="stat-label">Malicious</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--yellow)">${suspicious}</div><div class="stat-label">Suspicious</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--green)">${harmless}</div><div class="stat-label">Clean / Harmless</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val" style="color:var(--dim)">${undetected}</div><div class="stat-label">Undetected</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val" style="color:${rateColor}">${rate}%</div><div class="stat-label">Detection Rate</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val">${total}</div><div class="stat-label">Total Engines</div></div>
  `;

  document.getElementById('vt-results').style.display = '';
  vtFilterResults('all');
  toast(`Scan complete - ${malicious} / ${total} engines detected`, malicious > 0 ? 'warn' : 'ok');
}

function vtFilterResults(filter) {
  ['all','malicious','suspicious','clean'].forEach(f => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('vt-f-' + f);
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', f === filter);
  });

  const grid = document.getElementById('vt-engines-grid');
  let cards = '';
  const entries = Object.entries(_vtAllResults);

  for (const [engine, info] of entries) {
    const cat = info.category || 'undetected';
    if (filter === 'malicious'  && cat !== 'malicious')  continue;
    if (filter === 'suspicious' && cat !== 'suspicious') continue;
    if (filter === 'clean'      && !['harmless','clean','undetected'].includes(cat)) continue;

    const isMal = cat === 'malicious';
    const isSus = cat === 'suspicious';
    const cardCls  = isMal ? 'vt-mal' : isSus ? 'vt-sus' : 'vt-ok';
    const catColor = isMal ? 'var(--red)' : isSus ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--green)';
    const detection = info.result
      ? `<div class="vt-engine-detect">${escHtml(info.result)}</div>`
      : '';
    const ver = [info.engine_version, info.engine_update].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

    cards += `<div class="vt-engine-card ${cardCls}">
      <div class="vt-engine-head">
        <div class="vt-engine-name">${escHtml(engine)}</div>
        <span class="vt-cat-badge" style="background:${catColor}20;color:${catColor}">${cat}</span>
      </div>
      ${ver ? `<div class="vt-engine-ver">${escHtml(ver)}</div>` : ''}
      ${detection}
    </div>`;
  }

  if (!cards) {
    cards = '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">No results match the filter</div>';
  }
  grid.innerHTML = cards;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------
// YARA Generator

let _yaraSamples         = [];
let _yaraSelectedSession = '';
let _yaraSelectedFile    = '';
let _yaraCurrentRule     = '';
let _yaraCurrentName     = '';

let _yaraSelectedBuild = '';
let _yaraSelectedFname = '';

function yaraSetTab(tab) {
  document.getElementById('yara-src-sample').style.display = tab === 'sample' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-src-build').style.display  = tab === 'build'  ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-src-upload').style.display = tab === 'upload' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-tab-sample').className = tab === 'sample' ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
  document.getElementById('yara-tab-build').className  = tab === 'build'  ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
  document.getElementById('yara-tab-upload').className = tab === 'upload' ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-ghost btn-sm';
  if (tab === 'build' && !document.getElementById('yara-build-menu').children.length) {
    loadYaraBuilds();
  }
}

async function loadYaraBuilds() {
  const builds = await fetch('/api/logs?limit=50').then(r => r.json()).catch(() => []);
  const menu = document.getElementById('yara-build-menu');
  menu.innerHTML = '';
  const available = builds.filter(b => b.status === 'success' && b.binary_files?.length);
  if (!available.length) {
    menu.innerHTML = '<div class="vt-select-opt vt-ph">no compiled binaries found</div>';
    return;
  }
  for (const b of available) {
    const p   = b.params || {};
    let mod;
    if (p.slug)                       mod = p.slug;
    else if (p.malware === 'stealer') mod = p.stealer || b.id;
    else if (p.malware === 'ttp')     mod = p.meow_slug || p.attack_id || b.id;
    else                               mod = p.injection || b.id;
    for (const f of b.binary_files) {
      const label = `${b.id}  ·  ${mod}  (${f.name})  ${b.created?.slice(0,16)||''}`;
      const div   = document.createElement('div');
      div.className   = 'vt-select-opt';
      div.textContent = label;
      div.dataset.bid = b.id;
      div.dataset.fname = f.name;
      div.onclick = () => {
        _yaraSelectedBuild = b.id;
        _yaraSelectedFname = f.name;
        const lbl = document.getElementById('yara-build-label');
        lbl.textContent = label; lbl.className = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('#yara-build-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o =>
          o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.bid === b.id && o.dataset.fname === f.name));
        vtCloseDrop('yara-build-drop');
      };
      menu.appendChild(div);
    }
  }
}

async function yaraGenerateFromBuild() {
  const bid = _yaraSelectedBuild;
  if (!bid) { toast('Select a build first', 'warn'); return; }

  document.getElementById('yara-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-empty').style.display    = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress-title').textContent = 'Analysing build binary…';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress-fill').style.width  = '40%';
  document.getElementById('yara-build-gen-btn').disabled = true;

  const r = await fetch('/api/yara/from-build', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({build_id: bid, fname: _yaraSelectedFname || undefined}),
  }).then(r => r.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  document.getElementById('yara-progress').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-build-gen-btn').disabled = false;

  if (!r.ok) { toast('YARA error: ' + r.error, 'error'); document.getElementById('yara-empty').style.display = ''; return; }
  _yaraRenderResults(r, r.binary || 'binary');
}

async function loadYaraScanner() {
  _yaraSelectedSession = '';
  _yaraSelectedFile    = '';
  const samples = await fetch('/api/samples').then(r => r.json()).catch(() => []);
  _yaraSamples = samples;

  const menu = document.getElementById('yara-session-menu');
  menu.innerHTML = '';
  if (samples.length) {
    for (const s of samples) {
      const nf    = (s.files || []).length;
      const label = `${s.session_id}${s.actor ? '  ·  ' + s.actor : ''}  (${nf} file${nf !== 1 ? 's' : ''})`;
      const div   = document.createElement('div');
      div.className   = 'vt-select-opt';
      div.textContent = label;
      div.dataset.sid = s.session_id;
      div.onclick     = () => yaraSelectSession(s.session_id, label);
      menu.appendChild(div);
    }
  } else {
    menu.innerHTML = '<div class="vt-select-opt vt-ph">no samples found</div>';
  }
  document.getElementById('yara-file-menu').innerHTML = '';
  const sl = document.getElementById('yara-session-label'); sl.textContent = '- select session -'; sl.className = 'vt-ph';
  const fl = document.getElementById('yara-file-label');    fl.textContent = '- select file -';    fl.className = 'vt-ph';
}

function yaraSelectSession(sid, label) {
  _yaraSelectedSession = sid;
  const lbl = document.getElementById('yara-session-label');
  lbl.textContent = label; lbl.className = '';
  document.querySelectorAll('#yara-session-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o =>
    o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.sid === sid));
  vtCloseDrop('yara-session-drop');
  // populate file menu
  _yaraSelectedFile = '';
  const fMenu = document.getElementById('yara-file-menu');
  fMenu.innerHTML = '';
  const fl = document.getElementById('yara-file-label'); fl.textContent = '- select file -'; fl.className = 'vt-ph';
  const sample = _yaraSamples.find(s => s.session_id === sid);
  if (!sample || !(sample.files || []).length) {
    fMenu.innerHTML = '<div class="vt-select-opt vt-ph">no files found</div>'; return;
  }
  for (const f of sample.files) {
    const kb    = f.size > 1024 ? (f.size / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB' : f.size + ' B';
    const flabel = `${f.name}  (${kb})`;
    const div   = document.createElement('div');
    div.className     = 'vt-select-opt';
    div.textContent   = flabel;
    div.dataset.fname = f.name;
    div.onclick       = () => { _yaraSelectedFile = f.name; const l = document.getElementById('yara-file-label'); l.textContent = flabel; l.className = ''; document.querySelectorAll('#yara-file-menu .vt-select-opt').forEach(o => o.classList.toggle('vt-selected', o.dataset.fname === f.name)); vtCloseDrop('yara-file-drop'); };
    fMenu.appendChild(div);
  }
}

async function yaraGenerate() {
  const sid   = _yaraSelectedSession;
  const fname = _yaraSelectedFile;
  if (!sid || !fname) { toast('Select a session and file first', 'warn'); return; }

  document.getElementById('yara-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-empty').style.display    = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress-title').textContent = `Analysing ${fname}…`;
  document.getElementById('yara-progress-fill').style.width  = '40%';
  document.getElementById('yara-gen-btn').disabled = true;

  const r = await fetch('/api/yara/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({session_id: sid, filename: fname}),
  }).then(r => r.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  document.getElementById('yara-progress').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-gen-btn').disabled = false;

  if (!r.ok) { toast('YARA error: ' + r.error, 'error'); document.getElementById('yara-empty').style.display = ''; return; }
  _yaraRenderResults(r, fname);
}

function yaraHandleFile(file) {
  if (!file) return;
  document.getElementById('yara-drop-zone').querySelector('.yara-drop-title').textContent = file.name;
  yaraGenerateFromUpload(file);
}

function yaraHandleDrop(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('yara-drop-zone').classList.remove('drag-over');
  const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
  if (file) yaraHandleFile(file);
}

async function yaraGenerateFromUpload(file) {
  document.getElementById('yara-results').style.display  = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-empty').style.display    = 'none';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('yara-progress-title').textContent = `Analysing ${file.name}…`;
  document.getElementById('yara-progress-fill').style.width  = '40%';

  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append('file', file, file.name);
  const r = await fetch('/api/yara/upload', {method: 'POST', body: fd})
    .then(r => r.json()).catch(e => ({ok: false, error: String(e)}));

  document.getElementById('yara-progress').style.display = 'none';
  if (!r.ok) { toast('YARA error: ' + r.error, 'error'); document.getElementById('yara-empty').style.display = ''; return; }
  _yaraRenderResults(r, file.name);
}

function _yaraRenderResults(r, filename) {
  _yaraCurrentRule = r.rule;
  _yaraCurrentName = r.rule_name || 'peekaboo_rule';

  // badges
  const kb = r.size > 1048576 ? (r.size/1048576).toFixed(2)+' MB' : r.size > 1024 ? (r.size/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB' : r.size+' B';
  const badges = [
    {icon: '📁', label: filename, color: 'var(--blue)'},
    {icon: '📏', label: kb, color: 'var(--dim)'},
    {icon: '🔤', label: `${r.string_count} strings`, color: 'var(--yellow)'},
    r.has_pe ? {icon: '🗂️', label: `${r.pe_sections.length} PE sections`, color: 'var(--green)'} : null,
    r.pe_imphash ? {icon: '🔑', label: 'imphash', color: 'var(--purple)'} : null,
    r.high_entropy_count > 0 ? {icon: '⚠️', label: `${r.high_entropy_count} high-entropy section(s)`, color: 'var(--red)'} : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);

  document.getElementById('yara-badges').innerHTML = badges.map(b =>
    `<span class="yara-stat-badge" style="border-color:${b.color}20;color:${b.color}">${b.icon} ${escHtml(b.label)}</span>`
  ).join('');

  // hashes
  document.getElementById('yara-hash-md5').textContent    = r.md5;
  document.getElementById('yara-hash-sha256').textContent = r.sha256;

  // PE sections table
  if (r.has_pe && r.pe_sections.length) {
    document.getElementById('yara-sections-card').style.display = '';
    document.getElementById('yara-sections-list').innerHTML = r.pe_sections.map(s => {
      const pct   = Math.min(100, Math.round(s.entropy / 8 * 100));
      const color = s.entropy > 7 ? 'var(--red)' : s.entropy > 6 ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--green)';
      const kb2   = s.size > 1024 ? (s.size/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB' : s.size+' B';
      return `<div class="yara-section-row">
        <code class="yara-sec-name">${escHtml(s.name)}</code>
        <div class="yara-ent-bar"><div class="yara-ent-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${color}"></div></div>
        <span class="yara-sec-ent" style="color:${color}">${s.entropy}</span>
        <span class="yara-sec-size">${kb2}</span>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');
  } else {
    document.getElementById('yara-sections-card').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // syntax-highlighted rule
  const codeEl = document.getElementById('yara-code');
  codeEl.textContent = r.rule;
  if (typeof hljs !== 'undefined') { delete codeEl.dataset.highlighted; hljs.highlightElement(codeEl); }

  document.getElementById('yara-results').style.display = '';
  toast(`Rule "${_yaraCurrentName}" generated - ${r.string_count} string indicators`, 'ok');
}

function yaraCopy() {
  if (!_yaraCurrentRule) return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(_yaraCurrentRule).then(() => toast('Rule copied to clipboard', 'ok'));
}

function yaraDownload() {
  if (!_yaraCurrentRule) return;
  const blob = new Blob([_yaraCurrentRule], {type: 'text/plain'});
  const a    = document.createElement('a');
  a.href     = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = `${_yaraCurrentName}.yar`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
}

function initMitrePanel() {
  if (!_mitreStatsLoaded) _loadMitreStats();
  switchMitreTab(_mitreActiveTab, true);
}

async function _loadMitreStats() {
  _mitreStatsLoaded = true;
  const [libData, implData, extractData] = await Promise.all([
    fetch('/api/mitre/library?limit=1').then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({total:0})),
    fetch('/api/mitre/ttp_implementations?limit=1').then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({total:0})),
    fetch('/api/mitre/ttp_extracted?limit=1').then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({total:0})),
  ]);
  const total   = libData.total     || 0;
  const impl    = implData.total    || 0;
  const extract = extractData.total || 0;
  document.getElementById('mitre-stats-row').innerHTML = `
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val text-purple">${total}</div><div class="stat-label">Blog posts</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val text-green">${impl}</div><div class="stat-label">TTP implementations</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val text-cyan">${extract}</div><div class="stat-label">Extracted TTPs (LLM)</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="stat-val text-blue" id="mitre-stat-groups">...</div><div class="stat-label">APT groups</div></div>
  `;
  fetch('/api/mitre/groups?limit=1').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>{
    const el = document.getElementById('mitre-stat-groups');
    if (el) el.textContent = d.total || '...';
  }).catch(()=>{});
}

function switchMitreTab(tab, force) {
  if (tab === _mitreActiveTab && !force) return;
  if (tab !== _mitreActiveTab) closeMitreBrief();
  _mitreActiveTab = tab;
  ['groups','library','impl','extract'].forEach(t => {
    document.getElementById('mtab-' + t)?.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);
    const sec = document.getElementById('mitre-section-' + t);
    if (sec) sec.style.display = t === tab ? '' : 'none';
  });
  if (tab === 'groups')  _initGroupsTab();
  if (tab === 'library') _initLibTab();
  if (tab === 'impl')    _initImplTab();
  if (tab === 'extract') _initExtractTab();
}

// ===== HELPERS =====

function _pgBar(containerId, page, pages, total, searchFn) {
  const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!el) return;
  if (pages <= 1) { el.innerHTML = total > 0 ? `<span class="pg-info">${total} result${total!==1?'s':''}</span>` : ''; return; }
  const prev = `<button class="pg-btn" ${page===0?'disabled':''} onclick="${searchFn}(${page-1})">&laquo; Prev</button>`;
  const next = `<button class="pg-btn" ${page>=pages-1?'disabled':''} onclick="${searchFn}(${page+1})">Next &raquo;</button>`;
  const nums = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
    if (i===0 || i===pages-1 || Math.abs(i-page)<=1)
      nums.push(`<button class="pg-btn${i===page?' active':''}" onclick="${searchFn}(${i})">${i+1}</button>`);
    else if (nums[nums.length-1] !== '...')
      nums.push('...');
  }
  el.innerHTML = prev + nums.join('') + next + `<span class="pg-info">${total} result${total!==1?'s':''}</span>`;
}

function _spinner(id) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:24px;text-align:center"><div class="spinner" style="display:inline-block"></div></div>';
}

// ===== GROUPS TAB =====

let _groupsTabReady = false;

function _initGroupsTab() {
  if (_groupsTabReady) return;
  _groupsTabReady = true;
  // load first page automatically
  searchMitreGroups(0);
}

async function searchMitreGroups(page) {
  const q = document.getElementById('mg-q')?.value.trim() || '';
  _spinner('mg-rows');
  document.getElementById('mg-pages').innerHTML = '';
  const d = await fetch(`/api/mitre/groups?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&page=${page}&limit=10`)
    .then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({items:[],total:0,page:0,pages:1}));
  document.getElementById('mg-count').textContent = d.total ? `${d.total} group${d.total!==1?'s':''}` : '';
  _renderGroupRows(d.items);
  _pgBar('mg-pages', d.page, d.pages, d.total, 'searchMitreGroups');
}

function _renderGroupRows(groups) {
  const el = document.getElementById('mg-rows');
  if (!groups.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div>No groups found. Try a different search term.</div></div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="data-table">
      <thead><tr>
        <th>Group</th><th>Aliases</th><th>Description</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${groups.map(g => `
        <tr onclick="loadGroupTechniques('${escAttr(g.id)}','${escAttr(g.name)}')">
          <td><span style="font-weight:600;color:var(--purple)">${escHtml(g.name)}</span></td>
          <td><span class="text-dim text-xs">${(g.aliases||[]).slice(0,3).join(', ')}</span></td>
          <td><span class="text-xs text-dim" style="line-height:1.4">${escHtml((g.description||'').slice(0,90))}${(g.description||'').length>90?'...':''}</span></td>
        </tr>`).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table></div>`;
}

async function loadGroupTechniques(stixId, name) {
  const det = document.getElementById('mg-detail');
  det.style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('mg-detail-name').textContent = name;
  document.getElementById('mg-detail-sub').textContent = 'Loading techniques...';
  document.getElementById('mg-tech-rows').innerHTML =
    '<div style="padding:24px;text-align:center"><div class="spinner" style="display:inline-block"></div></div>';

  const techs = await fetch(`/api/mitre/group/${stixId}/techniques`).then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>[]);
  document.getElementById('mg-detail-sub').textContent = `${techs.length} technique${techs.length!==1?'s':''} used`;

  if (!techs.length) {
    document.getElementById('mg-tech-rows').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty"><div>No techniques found for this group</div></div>';
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('mg-tech-rows').innerHTML = `
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="data-table">
      <thead><tr>
        <th>ATT&amp;CK ID</th><th>Name</th><th>Tactic</th><th>Category</th><th>Blog</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${techs.map(t => {
        const tactic = (t.tactics||[]).slice(0,2).map(tc =>
          `<span class="badge badge-dim" style="font-size:9px">${tc.replace(/-/g,' ')}</span>`).join(' ');
        const c = MITRE_CAT_COLORS[t.category] || MITRE_CAT_COLORS.other;
        return `<tr>
          <td><span class="badge badge-red" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;cursor:pointer"
                    title="Detection brief"
                    onclick="showBrief('${escAttr(t.attack_id)}','art')">${escHtml(t.attack_id)}</span></td>
          <td style="font-weight:500">${escHtml(t.name)}</td>
          <td>${tactic}</td>
          <td><span class="badge" style="background:${c}22;color:${c};font-size:9px">${escHtml(t.category)}</span></td>
          <td>${t.blog_url ? `<a href="${escAttr(t.blog_url)}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-ghost btn-xs">Blog</a>` : '<span class="text-dim text-xs">-</span>'}</td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table></div>`;
  det.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest'});
}

function _renderLibRows(entries) {

      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${entries.map(e => {

          `<span class="badge badge-red" style="font-size:9px;font-family:var(--mono)">${escHtml(a)}</span>`).join(' ');

          <td style="font-weight:500;max-width:280px">${escHtml(e.title)}</td>

          <td><span class="badge" style="background:${c}22;color:${c};font-size:9px">${escHtml(e.category)}</span></td>

          <td>${e.src_path ? '<span class="badge badge-dim" style="font-size:9px">src</span>' : '<span class="text-dim text-xs">-</span>'}</td>
          <td><button class="btn-brief" onclick="event.stopPropagation();showBrief('${escAttr(e.slug)}','kb')">brief</button></td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('')}
      </tbody>
    </table></div>`;
}

async function openLibDetail(slug) {
  const det = document.getElementById('ml-detail');
  det.style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('ml-detail-title').textContent = 'Loading...';
  document.getElementById('ml-detail-meta').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('ml-detail-code').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('ml-detail-blog').style.display = 'none';

  const d = await fetch(`/api/mitre/library/entry/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`).then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>null);
  if (!d) {
    document.getElementById('ml-detail-title').textContent = 'Failed to load entry';
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('ml-detail-title').textContent = d.title || slug;

  const c   = MITRE_CAT_COLORS[d.category] || '#636366';
  const ids = (d.attack_ids||[]).map(a => `<span class="badge badge-red">${escHtml(a)}</span>`).join(' ');
  document.getElementById('ml-detail-meta').innerHTML = `
    <span class="badge" style="background:${c}22;color:${c}">${escHtml(d.category||'')}</span>
    ${ids}
    ${d.implemented ? '<span class="badge badge-green">peekaboo</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-dim">library only</span>'}
    <span class="badge badge-dim">${escHtml(d.date||'')}</span>`;

  const blogLink = document.getElementById('ml-detail-blog');
  if (d.blog_url) { blogLink.href = d.blog_url; blogLink.style.display = ''; }

  const src = d.full_source || d.snippet || '(no source available)';
  const ext = (d.src_path||'').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
  const langMap = {c:'language-c', cpp:'language-cpp', nim:'language-nim', asm:'language-x86asm', s:'language-x86asm'};
  const code = document.getElementById('ml-detail-code');
  code.className = langMap[ext] || 'language-c';
  code.textContent = src;
  if (typeof hljs !== 'undefined') { delete code.dataset.highlighted; hljs.highlightElement(code); }
  det.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest'});
}

async function rebuildLibCache() {
  toast('Rebuilding library cache...', 'info');
  await fetch('/api/mitre/library/rebuild', {method:'POST'});
  _libTabReady = false;
  _mitreStatsLoaded = false;
  _initLibTab();
  _loadMitreStats();
}

async function fetchQuickBrief() {
  const q = document.getElementById('qb-input').value.trim();
  if (!q) return;
  const wrap   = document.getElementById('qb-result');
  const slugEl = document.getElementById('qb-slug');
  const txtEl  = document.getElementById('qb-text');
  wrap.style.display = '';
  slugEl.textContent = q;
  txtEl.textContent = '…';

  // 1. exact slug match
  let r = await fetch(`/api/kb/brief/${encodeURIComponent(q)}`).then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>null);

  // 2. keyword fallback: search library, try each slug until one has a brief
  if (!r || r.error) {
    const lib = await fetch(`/api/mitre/library?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=8`)
      .then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>null);
    if (lib && lib.items) {
      for (const entry of lib.items) {
        const b = await fetch(`/api/kb/brief/${encodeURIComponent(entry.slug)}`).then(x=>x.json()).catch(()=>null);
        if (b && !b.error) { r = b; break; }
      }
    }
  }

  if (!r || r.error) {
    txtEl.textContent = 'No brief found for "' + q + '". Run: python worker.py summarize';
    return;
  }
  slugEl.textContent = r.slug;
  txtEl.textContent = '';
  let i = 0;
  const iv = setInterval(() => {
    if (i >= r.summary.length) { clearInterval(iv); return; }
    txtEl.textContent += r.summary[i++];
  }, 14);
}

// ===== SHARED BRIEF PANEL =====

let _briefIv = null;
let _briefRequestId = 0;

function closeMitreBrief() {
  document.getElementById('mitre-brief-panel').hidden = true;
  _briefRequestId++;
  if (_briefIv) { clearInterval(_briefIv); _briefIv = null; }
}

function closeBriefPanel() {
  document.getElementById('brief-panel').classList.remove('open');
  closeMitreBrief();
}

async function showBrief(id, type) {
  // type: 'kb'='kb_summaries', 'art'='artifact_summaries',
  //       'apt'='session_summaries', 'actor'='actor_summaries', 'family'='family_summaries'
  const inMitre = currentPanel === 'mitre';
  const panel  = document.getElementById(inMitre ? 'mitre-brief-panel' : 'brief-panel');
  const label  = document.getElementById(inMitre ? 'mbp-label' : 'bp-label');
  const slugEl = document.getElementById(inMitre ? 'mbp-slug' : 'bp-slug');
  const txtEl  = document.getElementById(inMitre ? 'mbp-text' : 'bp-text');
  if (_briefIv) { clearInterval(_briefIv); _briefIv = null; }
  if (!inMitre) closeMitreBrief();
  const requestId = ++_briefRequestId;

  const labelMap = {
    art:    'DETECTION BRIEF',
    apt:    'CAMPAIGN BRIEF',
    actor:  'ACTOR PROFILE',
    family: 'MALWARE FAMILY',
  };
  label.textContent = labelMap[type] || 'BRIEF';
  slugEl.textContent = id;
  txtEl.textContent = '…';
  if (inMitre) {
    document.getElementById('brief-panel').classList.remove('open');
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'nearest'});
  } else {
    panel.classList.add('open');
  }

  const urlMap = {
    art:    `/api/artifacts/brief/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
    apt:    `/api/apt/brief/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
    actor:  `/api/malpedia/actor/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/brief`,
    family: `/api/malpedia/family/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/brief`,
  };
  const workerMap = {
    art:    'python worker.py sigma',
    apt:    'python worker.py apt',
    actor:  'python worker.py actor',
    family: 'python worker.py family',
  };
  const url = urlMap[type] || `/api/kb/brief/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
  const r = await fetch(url).then(x => x.json()).catch(() => null);
  if (requestId !== _briefRequestId) return;
  if (!r || r.error) {
    const cmd = workerMap[type] || 'python worker.py summarize';
    txtEl.textContent = `No brief for "${id}". Run: ${cmd}`;
    return;
  }
  const text = r.summary || '';
  txtEl.textContent = '';
  let i = 0;
  _briefIv = setInterval(() => {
    if (i >= text.length) { clearInterval(_briefIv); _briefIv = null; return; }
    txtEl.textContent += text[i++];
  }, 13);
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------
// Malpedia
// -----------------------------------------------------------------
async function searchMalpedia() {
  const q = document.getElementById('malp-search').value.trim();
  if (!q) return;
  const el = document.getElementById('malp-results');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="loading-full" style="padding:10px"><div class="spinner"></div></div>';
  const d = await fetch(`/api/malpedia/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&type=${malpType}`).then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({actors:[],families:[]}));
  const items = [
    ...(d.actors||[]).map(a=>({id:a,type:'actor'})),
    ...(d.families||[]).map(f=>({id:f,type:'family'})),
  ];
  if (!items.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="text-dim text-sm">No results</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = items.map(i => `
    <div class="malp-result-row" onclick="loadMalpDetail('${escAttr(i.id)}','${i.type}')">
      <span class="badge ${i.type==='actor'?'badge-blue':'badge-purple'} text-xs">${i.type}</span>
      <span class="text-sm">${escHtml(i.id)}</span>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function setMalpType(t) {
  malpType = t;
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="malp-t-"]').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('malp-t-'+t)?.classList.add('active');
}

async function loadMalpDetail(id, type) {
  const card = document.getElementById('malp-detail-card');
  card.innerHTML = '<div class="loading-full" style="padding:20px"><div class="spinner"></div></div>';
  const url  = type === 'actor' ? `/api/malpedia/actor/${encodeURIComponent(id)}` : `/api/malpedia/family/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
  const data = await fetch(url).then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>({}));
  if (data.error) { card.innerHTML = `<div class="text-red text-sm">${escHtml(data.error)}</div>`; return; }
  const families = (data.families||[]).slice(0,8).map(f => `<span class="badge badge-dim text-xs">${escHtml(f.id)}</span>`).join('');
  const syns     = (data.synonyms||[]).slice(0,6).map(s => `<span class="badge badge-dim text-xs">${escHtml(s)}</span>`).join('');
  const posts    = (data.related_posts||[]).slice(0,4).map(p => `
    <div class="malp-post-row">
      <a href="${p.url||'#'}" target="_blank" class="malp-post-link">${escHtml(p.title||p.url||'')}</a>
      <span class="malp-post-date">${p.date||''}</span>
      ${p.slug ? `<button class="btn-brief" style="margin-left:6px" onclick="showBrief('${escAttr(p.slug)}','kb')">brief</button>` : ''}
    </div>`).join('');
  const briefBtn = type === 'actor'
    ? `<button class="btn-brief" onclick="showBrief('${escAttr(id)}','actor')" title="Threat actor profile brief">brief</button>`
    : `<button class="btn-brief" onclick="showBrief('${escAttr(id)}','family')" title="Malware family brief">brief</button>`;
  card.innerHTML = `
    <div class="card-header">
      <div>
        <div class="card-title">${escHtml(data.name||id)} ${briefBtn}</div>
        ${data.country ? `<div class="card-sub">${data.country}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    ${data.description ? `<div class="malp-desc">${escHtml(data.description.slice(0,400))}</div>` : ''}
    ${syns ? `<div class="malp-badge-row"><div class="malp-sec-label">Aliases</div>${syns}</div>` : ''}
    ${families ? `<div class="malp-badge-row"><div class="malp-sec-label">Malware Families</div>${families}</div>` : ''}
    ${posts ? `<div><div class="malp-sec-label">Related Posts</div>${posts}</div>` : ''}
    <div class="malp-actions">
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="prefillAPT('${escAttr(id)}')">🎯 Run Pipeline</button>
    </div>`;
}

function prefillAPT(actorId) {
  showPanel('apt');
  document.getElementById('apt-actor').value = actorId;
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------
let malpReports = [];

async function loadMalpReports() {
  const el = document.getElementById('malp-rep-list');
  const ld = document.getElementById('malp-rep-loading');
  el.innerHTML = '';
  ld.style.display = 'flex';
  try {
    malpReports = await fetch('/api/malpedia/reports?limit=50').then(r => r.json());
    if (!Array.isArray(malpReports)) malpReports = [];
  } catch(e) {
    malpReports = [];
  }
  ld.style.display = 'none';
  renderMalpReports(malpReports);
}

function renderMalpReports(reports) {
  const el = document.getElementById('malp-rep-list');
  if (!reports.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="padding:30px">No reports found</div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = reports.map(r => {
    const fams = (r.families||[]).map(f =>
      `<span class="badge badge-purple malp-fam-badge" onclick="event.preventDefault();document.getElementById('malp-search').value='${escAttr(f)}';searchMalpedia()">${escHtml(f)}</span>`
    ).join('');
    const org = r.org ? `<span class="badge badge-dim text-xs">${escHtml(r.org)}</span>` : '';
    const author = r.author && r.author !== r.org ? ` · ${escHtml(r.author)}` : '';
    return `<a class="rep-row" href="${escAttr(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div class="rep-date">${escHtml(r.date||'')}</div>
      <div class="rep-body">
        <div class="rep-title">${escHtml(r.title)}</div>
        <div class="rep-meta">${org}${author}</div>
        ${fams ? `<div class="rep-families">${fams}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
      <span class="malp-rep-arrow">↗</span>
    </a>`;
  }).join('');
}

function filterMalpReports() {
  const q = document.getElementById('malp-rep-search').value.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!q) { renderMalpReports(malpReports); return; }
  renderMalpReports(malpReports.filter(r =>
    (r.title||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    (r.org||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    (r.author||'').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    (r.families||[]).some(f => f.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  ));
}
